issues: The chart sat inside a small 1060px white card with 18–21px ticks and months that were unreadable at 1080p
Light grey stage, white card and amber line looked like every other light dashboard shot, with no design language
After breaking out, the spike was just a line hanging in the air; the ceiling gave no sense of being smashed
The end frame lacked hierarchy: a 32px value label, with no link between the yearly total and the header
changes: Sand paper look: the whole frame is a Swiss-grid finance poster with a 124px heavy headline, a same-size KPI top right, a full-bleed 1532×540 plot and 32px ticks and months
History area uses 45° print hatching, 3px ink baseline and ceiling rules, and ticks become left-aligned labels sitting on their rules
The spike accelerates through the ceiling: the rule cracks at the pierce point, three shards fly off, the chart gets a 10px damped shake, and the line drives into the KPI number, jolting it
168f timeline: rules draw, 42f write, 12f warning (ceiling turns terracotta, Nov pulses), 14f breakout, 18f hang, 14f rescale, label and KPI land, 42f hold
After the rescale a 76px terracotta value block '$340k ▲ 372% vs Nov' pops in, the KPI rolls to $833k in terracotta, with a 1.8% slow push throughout
